# IBuyAndBurnErrors
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/errors/IBuyAndBurnErrors.sol)

**Title:**
IBuyAndBurnErrors

These custom errors provide more gas-efficient and informative error handling
compared to traditional require statements with string messages.

This file contains custom error definitions for the BuyAndBurn contract.


## Errors
### BuyAndBurnAuctionAlreadyRunning
Thrown when attempting to start a new auction for a token that already has an ongoing auction.


```solidity
error BuyAndBurnAuctionAlreadyRunning(address tokenToAuction);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`tokenToAuction`|`address`|The address of the token for which an auction is already running.|

### BuyAndBurnAuctionParametersNotSet
Error thrown when trying to start an auction without setting parameters


```solidity
error BuyAndBurnAuctionParametersNotSet(address token);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|The address of the token for which the auction is being started|

### BuyAndBurnInvalidAuctionParameters
Error thrown when trying to set invalid auction parameters


```solidity
error BuyAndBurnInvalidAuctionParameters(address token);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|The address of the token for which the auction is being started|
